Synopsis:
    Deutsche Bank revised its ECB rate forecast upward, now expecting a December hike in addition to a September one, lifting the expected terminal rate to 2.75%. The revision is driven by persistent energy risks and resilient growth, though soft labour markets and contained wage pressures limit further upside beyond 3%. The article reflects a broader market consensus toward prolonged ECB tightening.
